blogs.title: The Attention Bottleneck: Why Transformers Struggle with Long Contexts
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly overview of the self‑attention mechanism, its quadratic cost, and why scaling sequence length has been a major challenge for large language models.

blogs.title: From FlashAttention‑2 to FlashAttention‑3: What Changed Under the Hood?
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step comparison of the two versions, focusing on new algorithmic tricks—warp‑specialization, producer‑consumer pipelines, and block‑wise GEMM/softmax overlap—that boost utilization on modern GPUs.

blogs.title: Asynchrony on Hopper GPUs: Turning Latency Into Speed
blogs.description: Explains how the Hopper architecture’s Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) and asynchronous Tensor Cores let FlashAttention‑3 hide memory and compute latencies using a producer‑consumer warp model.

blogs.title: FP8 Low‑Precision Attention: Twice the Throughput Without Losing Accuracy
blogs.description: Demystifies FP8 arithmetic, block quantization, and incoherent processing techniques used in FlashAttention‑3 to achieve near‑PFLOP performance while keeping numerical error low.

blogs.title: Real‑World Benchmarks: FlashAttention‑3 on the H100 GPU
blogs.description: Presents concrete speedup numbers—up to 2× faster than FlashAttention‑2—and explains what TFLOPs/s and utilization percentages mean for developers training or serving LLMs.

blogs.title: Practical Guide: Integrating FlashAttention‑3 into PyTorch & Hugging Face
blogs.description: Walks readers through installing the open‑source library, swapping out the default attention kernel, and measuring gains in typical transformer workloads.

blogs.title: Looking Ahead: How Faster, More Accurate Attention Enables New AI Applications
blogs.description: Discusses the broader impact of FlashAttention‑3—long‑context reasoning, multimodal models, and more efficient LLM inference—and outlines open research directions.
